name: Rust Error Handling
description: Guides expert-level Rust error handling: thiserror vs anyhow decision tree, error propagation with ? operator, custom error types, Result combinators, and error conversion patterns. Use when the user asks about Rust error handling, thiserror, anyhow, Result type, ? operator, custom errors, error propagation. Do NOT use when the user asks about Rust ownership (use `rust-ownership-patterns`), Rust project setup (use `rust-project-setup`), Rust testing (use `rust-testing-patterns`).
